bullets: Unique Origin & Premium Materials. Anxi County boasts a one-of-a-kind geographical environment that provides ideal growing conditions for tieguanyin tea. It features a subtropical monsoon climate with abundant rainfall, an average annual temperature of 16–21°C, and relative humidity above 78%. Most soil is acidic red earth with a deep layer, perfect for tea cultivation.

Exquisite Craftsmanship & Meticulous Production. Tieguanyin oolong tea involves a complex production process, including plucking, leaf-shaking, fixation, rolling,ect.. Plucking only takes place on sunny days, following strict standards: mature shoots with two or three leaves are selectively picked. During fixation, tea masters adjust heat and timing based on leaf condition, short processing to preserve color, aroma, and taste.

Each Grain Is Firm And Plump. Tie guan yin tea oolong tea leaves are tight, sturdy, and heavy in hand, with a glossy sand-green color. After infusion, the liquor is golden and bright like amber. The brewed leaves are thick, soft, and glossy, featuring the iconic green leaves with red edges.

Richly Aromatic with a Mellow, Lingering Sweetness. Chinese Iron Goddess of Mercy boasts a clear, bright infusion that is smooth and translucent, refreshingly crisp and sweet. Its distinct fragrance is accompanied by a long-lasting, sweet aftertaste.

Nutrient-Rich. Grade AAA Oolong Tea Leaves contains various amino acids, tea polyphenols, caffeine, tea polysaccharides, and other nutritional components. Drinking Tieguanyin tea not only hydrates the body but also replenishes essential minerals due to its mineral-rich composition. It leaves one feeling refreshed and alert, aids in digestion, and promotes mental clarity.

bullets: From FuDing, Fujian — Shou Mei white tea from local mountain gardens. A large-leaf grade with whole leaves and stems.
Aged for Years, Then Pressed — Leaves dry in daylight and rest for years. After that they get pressed into a 100g cake.
Aged Aroma, Amber Soup — The dry cake smells warm, of dried leaves and wood. The soup brews clear amber and stays clear.
Mellow and Sweet — Soft in the mouth and sweet after you swallow. The aged taste is round and holds up over many steeps.
Brew and Store — 5g per 150ml at 194-203°F, re-steep 4 to 5 times. Packed in a thick foil bag that blocks light and seals tight.
